--- read this as ---
  addEventListener + clientX/offsetX in the shell  -> it takes DOM input;
     synthetic pointer events at coordinates should reach the module.
  CommBus/callWasm/Coherent.trigger with coordinates -> even better: we can
     call that channel directly and skip DOM synthesis entirely.
  neither -> the sim routes cockpit input to the gauge natively and no
     DOM-level scheme reaches WASM instruments. A350/A400M/PMDG are out.

  Full sources on window.__P01 — __P01.show('WasmInstrument'), __P01.find('mouse')
